senses.gloss:
Sautra root. 10th cl. (चिह्नयति)
To mark, to spot, to stamp.

n. (-ह्नं)
1 A mark of any kind, a spot, stain, sign, symbol, &c.
2 A banner, a standard.
3 A symptom.
E.
चह to pound, affix नक्, and the radical vowel changed to इ, or चिह्न to mark, क aff.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
1 Spotting, marking.
2 Hideous, frightful.
3 Striking, killing.
E.
चिह्न, and कारिन् who or what makes.

f. (-णी)
A plant, (Echites frutescens.)
E.
चिह्न a mark, and धारिणी possessing.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Marked, spotted, stained, stamped.
2 Designated.
3 Known.
E.
चिह्न to mark, and क्त aff.
